response_text: 1. (Currently amended) A computing system for authoring a document, comprising: __one or more processors and a memory storing instructions that, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the computing system to__: (1) receive first user input identifying content to be included in the document, the identified content being in a first form, and (2) receive second user input specifying a transformation operation to be performed on the identified content in order to transform the identified content from the first form into a second form; and __apply__ the specified transformation operation to transform the identified content from the first form into the second form for display.
